feature_camera_enabled.description: Shows the camera screen with pose outlines as the start screen.

feature_in_app_review_enabled.description: Asks for a Play review after enough saved photos (core/review rules).

feature_loading_enabled.description: Shows the loading screen that prepares the app before the start screen.

feature_network_dialog_enabled.description: Shows the dialog that blocks the app while the device has no usable Internet.

feature_onboarding_enabled.description: Shows the welcome screens and the camera permission request on first open.

feature_pose_matching_enabled.description: Shows the live pose match score on the camera.

feature_poses_enabled.description: Shows the pose library button on the camera and the library screens.

feature_sample_enabled.description: Shows the sample feature screen, the reference pattern for new features.

feature_settings_enabled.description: Shows the settings button and the settings screen.

pose_match_min_in_frame_percent.description: Confidence in percent, 1 to 99, from which a body point counts as in the frame; out of range uses 50.

pose_match_threshold.description: Score, 1 to 100, from which the pose on the camera counts as matched; out of range uses 80.

privacy_policy_url.description: Address of the privacy policy page opened from settings.

ads_interval.description: Minimum time between two full-screen ads of the default interval group, in seconds.

ads_mediation_order.description: Order of the two ad platforms for banner, MREC, interstitial, rewarded and resume app open ads: admob, max, admob_max or max_admob; any other value uses max_admob. Without a MAX SDK key in the build, admob. Name set by the template, not an AdsKit key.

ads_review_interstitial_breaks_between.description: Saved photos (items) between two review_interstitial ads. Name set by the app, not an AdsKit key.

ads_review_interstitial_first_break.description: First saved photo of the session (counted in items) that may show review_interstitial. Name set by the app, not an AdsKit key.

is_enable_consent_shortcut.description: Remote switch of ERROR_ALLOWED, the temporary right when UMP fails on the network (S-12); also needs the build setting of the app. CACHED_EARLY is always on (ADR-0038). False takes ERROR_ALLOWED back at once. Name set by the template, not an AdsKit key.

is_log_ad_fullscreen_events.description: Logs the Firebase lifecycle events of full-screen ads. Name set by the template, not an AdsKit key.

is_log_ad_slot_events.description: Logs the Firebase lifecycle events of ad slots (banner, native). Name set by the template, not an AdsKit key.

is_show_ads.description: Master switch for every ad. When false, the app loads and shows no ad at all. Name set by the template, not an AdsKit key.

is_show_gallery_app_open.description: Shows ads in this placement. Off by default. Staging ad gallery only. Derived key of placement gallery_app_open (app_open).

is_show_gallery_banner.description: Shows ads in this placement. Off by default. Staging ad gallery only. Derived key of placement gallery_banner (banner).

is_show_gallery_banner_collapsible.description: Shows ads in this placement. Off by default. Staging ad gallery only. Derived key of placement gallery_banner_collapsible (banner_collapsible).

is_show_gallery_banner_mrec.description: Shows ads in this placement. Off by default. Staging ad gallery only. Derived key of placement gallery_banner_mrec (banner_mrec).

is_show_gallery_in_collection.description: Shows ads in this placement. Off by default. Staging ad gallery only. Derived key of placement gallery_in_collection (native_in_collection).

is_show_gallery_inlist_medium.description: Shows ads in this placement. Off by default. Staging ad gallery only. Derived key of placement gallery_inlist_medium (native_medium).

is_show_gallery_inlist_small.description: Shows ads in this placement. Off by default. Staging ad gallery only. Derived key of placement gallery_inlist_small (native_small).

is_show_gallery_interstitial.description: Shows ads in this placement. Off by default. Staging ad gallery only. Derived key of placement gallery_interstitial (interstitial).

is_show_gallery_native_full_screen.description: Shows ads in this placement. Off by default. Staging ad gallery only. Derived key of placement gallery_native_full_screen (native_fullscreen).

is_show_gallery_native_medium.description: Shows ads in this placement. Off by default. Staging ad gallery only. Derived key of placement gallery_native_medium (native_medium).

is_show_gallery_native_small.description: Shows ads in this placement. Off by default. Staging ad gallery only. Derived key of placement gallery_native_small (native_small).

is_show_gallery_native_step.description: Shows ads in this placement. Off by default. Staging ad gallery only. Derived key of placement gallery_native_step (native_step).

is_show_gallery_native_step_full.description: Shows ads in this placement. Off by default. Staging ad gallery only. Derived key of placement gallery_native_step_full (native_fullscreen).

is_show_gallery_rw_action.description: Shows ads in this placement. Off by default. Staging ad gallery only. Derived key of placement gallery_rw_action (rewarded).

is_show_inter_pose_detail.description: Shows ads in this placement. Off by default. Derived key of placement inter_pose_detail (interstitial).

is_show_native_after_inter.description: Shows a full-screen native ad right after an interstitial (combo).

is_show_native_bottom.description: Bottom slot of every bottom ad bar: a small native ad when true, a banner when false.

is_show_native_collap.description: Collapsible native layer on the bottom ad bar, only when is_show_native_bottom is also true. Name set by the template, not an AdsKit key.

is_show_pose_detail_bottom.description: Shows ads in this placement. Off by default. Derived key of placement pose_detail_bottom (native_small).

is_show_poses_bottom.description: Shows ads in this placement. Off by default. Derived key of placement poses_bottom (native_small).

is_show_review_interstitial.description: Shows ads in this placement. Off by default. Derived key of placement review_interstitial (interstitial).

is_show_sample_native_small.description: Shows ads in this placement. Off by default. Derived key of placement sample_native_small (native_small).

native_every_gallery_in_collection.description: Number of items between two native ads of this placement, in items. Derived key of placement gallery_in_collection (native_in_collection).

native_every_gallery_inlist_medium.description: Number of items between two native ads of this placement, in items. Derived key of placement gallery_inlist_medium (native_medium).

native_every_gallery_inlist_small.description: Number of items between two native ads of this placement, in items. Derived key of placement gallery_inlist_small (native_small).

open_ad_type.description: Ad shown when the app opens: inter for an interstitial, any other value for an app open ad.

resume_ad_type.description: Ad shown when the user comes back: only inter gives an interstitial, any other value an app open ad.

show_open_ads.description: Shows the ad when the app opens, from the second open on.

show_open_ads_first_open.description: Shows the ad when the app opens for the first time after install.

show_resum_ads.description: Shows an ad when the user comes back to the app. Name kept with the AdsKit typo.

time_close_native.description: Countdown before the full-screen native ad can be closed, in seconds; 1 to 30, any other value uses 5. Name from JBase, not an AdsKit key.

time_expand_collap_ad.description: Time after the user collapses the collapsible native ad before it expands again, in seconds; 0 means never. Name set by the template, not an AdsKit key.

is_log_af_ad_revenue.description: Sends af_ad_revenue for every paid ad impression. AppsFlyer event switch. Name set by the template, not an AdsKit key.

is_log_af_inters_ad_eligible.description: Sends af_inters_ad_eligible. AppsFlyer event switch. Name set by the template, not an AdsKit key.

is_log_af_inters_api_called.description: Sends af_inters_api_called. AppsFlyer event switch. Name set by the template, not an AdsKit key.

is_log_af_inters_displayed.description: Sends af_inters_displayed. AppsFlyer event switch. Name set by the template, not an AdsKit key.

is_log_af_inters_displayed_n_times.description: Sends af_inters_displayed_{N}_times. AppsFlyer event switch. Name set by the template, not an AdsKit key.

is_log_af_native_ad_displayed.description: Sends af_native_ad_displayed. AppsFlyer event switch. Name set by the template, not an AdsKit key.

is_log_af_native_ad_eligible.description: Sends af_native_ad_eligible. AppsFlyer event switch. Name set by the template, not an AdsKit key.

is_log_af_native_api_called.description: Sends af_native_api_called. AppsFlyer event switch. Name set by the template, not an AdsKit key.

is_log_af_rewarded_ad_displayed.description: Sends af_rewarded_ad_displayed. AppsFlyer event switch. Name set by the template, not an AdsKit key.

is_log_af_rewarded_ad_eligible.description: Sends af_rewarded_ad_eligible. AppsFlyer event switch. Name set by the template, not an AdsKit key.

is_log_af_rewarded_api_called.description: Sends af_rewarded_api_called. AppsFlyer event switch. Name set by the template, not an AdsKit key.

network_lost_delay_seconds.description: Seconds the device must report no network before the dialog that blocks the app shows.

poses_catalog_path.description: Path on R2 of the pose catalog; an invalid path falls back to the default.

in_app_review_min_days_between.description: Days between two requests of the Play review dialog.

in_app_review_min_saved_photos.description: Photos saved since install before the Play review dialog may be asked for.
